title: nan
authors: Ilyas M.; Cho K.; Park S.; Baeg S.-H.
key_contribution: Presents a dependable multi-sensor fusion navigation technique for UGVs in GPS-denied environments using GPS, encoders, and INS aiding with a sensor quality module, validated experimentally.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
